content_sections.heading: Territorial Army Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: Vacancies are subject to change as per organizational requirement. Category-wise/reservation-wise break-up has not been provided in the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Territorial Army Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Eligible Candidates: Only Ex-Service Commissioned Officers can apply. Nationality: Only citizens of India (male and female). Employment Status: Applicant must be gainfully employed. Not Eligible: Serving members of the Regular Army, Navy, Air Force, Police, GREF, Para Military and similar forces cannot apply. Candidates must be a graduate from a recognized university. Candidates must be between 18 and 42 years of age as on the date of application. Candidates must be physically and medically fit in all respects.

content_sections.heading: Territorial Army Salary Structure 2026 (7th CPC Pay Scale)
content_sections.text: Commission is granted in the rank of Lieutenant, subject to fulfilling requirements laid down in TA Rule 20A. Pay and allowances are the same as Regular Army officers when embodied for training and military service. Promotions up to Lt Colonel are by time scale (subject to fulfilling laid-down criteria), while promotion to Colonel and Brigadier is by selection.

content_sections.heading: Territorial Army Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: Ex-Service Officers will be screened by the Army Headquarters Selection Board (ASB) held at Directorate General Territorial Army (TA-4), Integrated Headquarters of Ministry of Defence, 4th Floor, 'A' Block, Ministry of Defence Office Complex, KG Marg, New Delhi - 110001. Based on the total number of applications received, Army HQ reserves the right to call up a limited number of applicants for interview. Candidates who do not receive a call-up letter will have their candidature deemed cancelled. Type of exam: Only an interview is conducted (no written exam). Eligible candidates will be issued a call-up letter and sent notification by e-mail through the Territorial Army Directorate.

content_sections.heading: Embodiment for Training
content_sections.text: Candidates commissioned in the Territorial Army will undergo Pre-Commission Training as provided under TA Rule 20A. Two months' Annual Training Camp is required every year, including the first year (as applicable).

content_sections.heading: Terms and Conditions of Service
content_sections.text: Territorial Army service is a part-time concept with mandatory two months' training every year; it does not provide a full-time career. Territorial Army duty does not guarantee pension, and service is subject to embodied service as per organisational requirement.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for Territorial Army Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Ex-Service Officers must bring the following documents in original along with self-attested copies at the time of interview: Application Form IAF (TA)-9 (Revised) Part-2, filled in own handwriting All educational qualification certificates (from Matric onwards) Latest physical fitness certificate from a registered MBBS doctor Copy of identity proof with photograph (Voter ID/PAN Card/Aadhar Card/Passport/Driving License) Domicile/residential proof Certificate for proof of age (Matric/Senior Secondary mark sheet and certificate) Service certificate (for candidates employed in Central Govt/UT/State/Semi Govt/Private sector), authenticated by the head of office, along with a No Objection Certificate For self-employed candidates: an affidavit on non-judicial stamp paper stating nature of employment and annual income, along with a photocopy of PAN card and a self-certified character certificate Gazette notification copy (for officers whose name varies across documents) Copy of Release Order Copy of Release Medical Board Proceedings Latest income proof from the appropriate authority (Income Tax Department/Magistrate/Employer) Copy of PAN Card Copy of Aadhar Card Copy of certificates/reports of all courses Discharge/Service Particular Booklet Copy of latest Income Tax Return (ITR) filed Additionally, candidates are required to submit specific certificates at the time of interview, such as a certificate from the employer confirming release for training/embodiment, a self-certified good moral character certificate, and (for self-employed candidates) a notarised affidavit confirming residence, self-employment status, and approximate annual income. The exact formats are provided in the official notification.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for Territorial Army Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Download the Application Form IAF (TA)-9 (Revised) Part-1 from the official website www.indianarmy.nic.in (free of cost). Fill up the application form in your own handwriting. Attach the Release Order and Photocopy of the Release Medical Board Proceedings along with the application. Send the completed application to: Directorate General Territorial Army, Integrated Headquarters of Ministry of Defence, 4th Floor, 'A' Block, Ministry of Defence Office Complex, KG Marg, New Delhi - 110001. Applications must be sent by India Post only. Ensure the application reaches the office on or before 25 August 2026.

faq.question: Q1. Who can apply for Territorial Army Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Only gainfully employed Ex-Service Commissioned Officers, who are citizens of India (male and female), can apply for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for Territorial Army Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application is 25 August 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for Territorial Army Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must be between 18 and 42 years of age as on the date of application.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are there in Territorial Army Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 5 vacancies in total - 4 for male candidates and 1 for female candidates, subject to change as per organizational requirement.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any written exam for Territorial Army ASB Ex Officers Recruitment?
faq.answer: No, only an interview is conducted; there is no written examination for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. Can serving Army/Navy/Air Force officers apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, serving members of the Regular Army, Navy, Air Force, Police, GREF, Para Military and similar forces are not eligible to apply.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee for Territorial Army Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The official notification does not mention any application fee; the application form is available free of cost.
